mechanism_a_electric_streamer.definition: available = a Basic {L} in hand AND Bellibolt ex in play

mechanism_b_voltaic_chain.note: counted by the expert over decisions where an attack was the chosen phase and Voltaic Chain was legal; see expert counters in the raw traces

next_loss_mode.statement: Both counter mechanisms execute whenever they are available, but the Bellibolt engine comes online later than the damage race requires: Thunderous Bolt cannot attack on consecutive turns and Voltaic Chain only reaches competitive damage once several {L} are already in play, so the deck spends its early turns developing while the opponent scores.
next_loss_mode.why_single: it is the one measurement that explains a high mechanism-execution rate coexisting with a low score rate; every other observed weakness is downstream of arriving late.
